card.name: Google and tech product names
card.fires_on: The word Google (also System in Mac menus) when naming web services, apps, or software products in tech help text. Mostly the word right after 'the', 'to', or 'on' before another product word.

modes.label: Google as a service name
modes.description: The word Google before another product word such as Play Store, Reader, or maps.
modes.example: Apple App Store and the<< Google>> Play Store.

modes.label: Software menu and version terms
modes.description: Names of operating system menus or version numbers in computer instructions.

card.plain: It lights up on the word Google and similar software names in web and computer how-to text.
